blocking_decisions.decision: Option A: Clerk JWT custom claim. tenantId embedded in session token at login. Pattern in libs/integrations/clerk/session-context.ts (buildSessionClaims + CspsSessionClaims type). Zero DB lookup per request. Full wiring at Phase 5 app route.

Option A: 4 values — free|trialing|active|cancelled. Added to tenant.zmodel + Prisma schema. Default: free. Billing trigger: status updates when Stripe subscription created (2nd UserTenant join per VLT-S014-005).

Option A: Supabase Supavisor transaction mode. DATABASE_URL uses pooler endpoint with ?pgbouncer=true&connection_limit=1. DIRECT_URL bypasses pooler for migrations. Documented in apps/sandbox/.env.example.

Option B (Postgres trigger) deferred until ZenStack install. Interim: Clerk's own audit log covers auth events. Trigger DDL documented in libs/policies/audit-triggers.sql (commented, ready to uncomment).

Option A: tsconfig paths alias. apps/sandbox/tsconfig.json updated with @csps/integrations → ../../libs/integrations/index.ts. Each new app adds same alias. libs/integrations/index.ts barrel is the canonical export.
Tasks + Projects (Option B). No Milestones at v1. Milestones can be added later without schema breakage.
One workspace per tenant (Option A). Workspace IS the Tenant. Already implemented via Tenant.clerkOrgId. Multiple workspaces = create multiple Clerk orgs.
$1K MRR graduation trigger (Option B). Measured via Stripe webhooks → AuditEvent. Governor manual override always available.
Free solo / paid team (Option C). Free when UserTenant count = 1. Paid when 2+ members join tenant. Stripe billing triggers on second UserTenant creation.

AI session quality tracked (EP-NNN learning — platform gets smarter after every failure)
Multi-tenant RLS enforced from day 1 — not a retrofit risk
